turns.utterance: All checks complete. The protective window and lens are clear, the beam path enclosure is intact with no contamination, and the mounting ring is secure.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the protective window and lens for spatter pitting or residue. 2. Check the beam path enclosure for damage or contamination ingress. 3. Inspect the lens mounting ring for looseness or mechanical damage.

turns.utterance: Is the lens or beam path window scratched, chipped or contaminated?

turns.utterance: No, both the lens and window are clean with no scratches or chips visible.

turns.utterance: Is the laser head temperature within rated operating range?

turns.utterance: Yes, the laser head temperature is well within the rated range.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the beam centred within 0.1 mm of field centre?

turns.utterance: Yes, the burn mark is centered well within the 0.1 millimeter tolerance.

turns.utterance: Is the output power within plus or minus 5% of rated value at 100% duty cycle?

turns.utterance: No, the measured power is about 7% below the rated value.

turns.utterance: Navigate to the laser power calibration menu in the marking software. Place the calibrated power meter at the focal plane and follow the on-screen sequence. Record the measured output power and confirm it meets the specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Calibration routine completed. The power meter is in position and the sequence has finished.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Navigate to the laser power calibration menu in the marking software. 2. Place the calibrated power meter at the focal plane and follow the on-screen sequence. 3. Record the measured output power and confirm it meets the specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify output power after calibration routine.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify output power after calibration routine

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Power is now reading within specification after the calibration.

turns.utterance: Is the pulse frequency stable at all programmed values?

turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing some variation in the pulse frequency that exceeds the tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Pulse frequency stable at all programmed values?

turns.utterance: Inspect the Q switch driver board connections and clean the circuit board.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Connections inspected and tightened, circuit board cleaned.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount the graduated focal test sample in the marking fixture at the nominal standoff distance. Mark a line across the full graduation range while stepping focus in 0.5 millimetre increments per segment. Inspect the marked line under a magnifier and identify the segment with the narrowest, cleanest line width.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount the graduated focal test sample in the marking fixture at the nominal standoff distance. Mark a line across the full graduation range while stepping focus in 0.5 millimetre increments per segment. Inspect the marked line under a magnifier and identify the segment with the narrowest, cleanest line width; record the corresponding focus offset and compare against the value stored in the machine setup parameter table.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test sample marked and inspected. I've identified the optimal focus position and recorded the offset value.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount the graduated focal test sample in the marking fixture at the nominal standoff distance. Mark a line across the full graduation range while stepping focus in 0.5 millimetre increments per segment. Inspect the marked line under a magnifier and identify the segment with the narrowest, cleanest line width; record the corresponding focus offset and compare against the value stored in the machine setup parameter table.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the focal point at correct working distance plus or minus 0.2 mm?

turns.utterance: No, the focal point is off by about 0.4 millimeters from the correct working distance.

ground_truth.node_text: Focal point at correct working distance ±0.2 mm?

turns.utterance: Adjust the z axis focus offset in the marking controller.

turns.utterance: Z axis focus offset adjusted in the controller.

turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity in metres per second and calculate volumetric flow rate from the duct cross sectional area.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. Record the air velocity in metres per second and calculate volumetric flow rate from the duct cross sectional area. turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Air velocity measured and flow rate calculated from the duct area.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated anemometer probe at the extraction port inlet while the extraction unit is running at the operating duty cycle. turns.utterance: Is the extraction flow rate above minimum required value?

ground_truth.node_text: Extraction flow rate above minimum required value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the flow rate is below the minimum requirement.

ground_truth.node_text: Extraction flow rate above minimum required value?

turns.utterance: Replace the extraction filter cartridge and recheck flow.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace extraction filter cartridge and recheck flow

turns.utterance: Filter cartridge replaced and flow rechecked.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace extraction filter cartridge and recheck flow

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port.

ground_truth.node_text: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port. Do not touch mirror surfaces; if spatter deposits are found that cannot be cleared by air, log the condition and schedule mirror replacement at the next planned maintenance window.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Scan head cover removed, mirrors inspected and cleaned with compressed air.

ground_truth.node_text: Remove the scan head cover and inspect each galvo mirror surface under a torch at grazing incidence for dust, spatter deposits, or surface oxidation. Blow clean with dry compressed air through the scan head purge port. Do not touch mirror surfaces; if spatter deposits are found that cannot be cleared by air, log the condition and schedule mirror replacement at the next planned maintenance window.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

ground_truth.node_text: Galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: No, there are some spatter deposits that didn't clear with air alone.

ground_truth.node_text: Galvo mirror surfaces clean and undamaged?

turns.utterance: Clean the galvo mirrors using the specialist mirror cleaning procedure.

turns.utterance: Galvo mirrors cleaned using the specialist procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Clean galvo mirrors using specialist mirror cleaning procedure

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the standard reference substrate into the marking fixture and run the standard test mark program. ground_truth.node_text: Load the standard reference substrate into the marking fixture and run the standard test mark program. Inspect the produced marks under a reference illumination source and confirm that line width, depth, and contrast are within the limits recorded on the product mark quality standard. Document the substrate lot number and the test result in the laser log.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Reference substrate loaded, test marks produced and inspected. Substrate lot number and results documented in the laser log.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the standard reference substrate into the marking fixture and run the standard test mark program. Document the substrate lot number and the test result in the laser log.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all 10 test marks within depth, width and contrast specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 test marks within depth, width and contrast specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all ten marks meet the depth, width, and contrast specifications.

turns.utterance: Navigate to the field distortion correction menu in the marking software. Place the field calibration target on the work surface at nominal focal distance. Run the correction routine and verify residual field error is within tolerance.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Field distortion correction routine completed and residual error verified.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Navigate to the field distortion correction menu in the marking software. 2. Place the field calibration target on the work surface at nominal focal distance. 3. Run the correction routine and verify residual field error is within tolerance.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load five consecutive production parts and run the production marking program at normal production parameters. ground_truth.node_text: Load five consecutive production parts and run the production marking program at normal production parameters. Inspect each mark immediately after completion for completeness, position, contrast, and absence of spatter. turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Five production parts marked and inspected. Serial numbers and results recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Load five consecutive production parts and run the production marking program at normal production parameters. Inspect each mark immediately after completion for completeness, position, contrast, and absence of spatter. Record the part serial numbers and the pass or fail result for each; any fail at this stage requires recalibration before production release.

turns.utterance: Do the production samples meet drawing marking requirements?

ground_truth.node_text: Production samples meet drawing marking requirements?

turns.utterance: No, the production samples are failing the marking requirements.

ground_truth.node_text: Production samples meet drawing marking requirements?

turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Mark quality is unrecoverable. Escalate to process engineering for review and do not release this station to production.
